name: introspection
description: Create, migrate, deploy, improve, and operate vertical agents on Introspection.

interface.shortDescription: Build, ship, and operate production agents
interface.longDescription: Create focused recipes from scratch or templates, migrate existing agents, deploy through the Introspection CLI, improve from production evidence or a chosen target, and operate a live project.
defaultPrompt: Use $introspection:create for a new agent, or $introspection:migrate to preserve an existing agent.
Use $introspection:improve with an optional focus, or omit it to start from production evidence.
Use $introspection:deploy to publish and verify a proven recipe.
Use $introspection:operate to inspect a live project, explain a task, or change platform state.
